name: New Incentives
summary: Small cash incentives for caregivers who bring infants for routine vaccinations in northern Nigeria. A re-implementation of GiveWell's model. GiveWell models 40 locations; this page shows Nigeria (Bayelsa), the median location by cost-effectiveness. The others are listed below.
